post_topic: Shipping invisible fixes: dead integration removal and attribution gap closure in Showing Signal
image_description:
Single standalone diagram. One concept only. No panels, no grids, no collages. Full bleed 1080x1080px white background.

A horizontal left-to-right flow diagram titled 'Showing Signal: Two Silent Fixes' in bold navy at the top center.

The diagram is divided into two clearly labeled horizontal rows, stacked top and bottom — not side by side panels. Row labels appear on the far left as vertical text: top row labeled 'Before' in amber #F5A623, bottom row labeled 'After' in blue #5a96ff.

Top row (Before): Five nodes connected left to right by arrows. Node 1: rounded rectangle labeled 'Marketing Copy / Checkout Page', navy fill. Arrow right. Node 2: rounded rectangle labeled 'Onboarding Flow', navy fill. Arrow right. Node 3: rounded rectangle labeled 'CRM Integration (Vendor Shutdown)', red fill with a bold red X overlay and a small strikethrough label 'Dead End'. Arrow right. Node 4: rounded rectangle labeled 'Signup Form', navy fill. Arrow right to Node 5: rounded rectangle labeled 'Backend', navy fill — but the arrow between Node 4 and Node 5 is dashed and amber-colored with a label above it reading 'Referral / Campaign Attribution — NOT CAPTURED' in amber.

Bottom row (After): Same five-node flow. Node 1 and Node 2 identical to above. Node 3 is now completely absent — replaced by a small gray placeholder box labeled 'Integration Removed' with no arrow leading into or out of it, visually disconnected from the flow. The main flow arrow skips past it cleanly. Node 4: 'Signup Form', navy fill. Arrow right to Node 5: 'Backend', navy fill — this time the arrow is solid blue #5a96ff with a label above it reading 'Attribution Captured ✓' in blue.

Below the two rows, a single centered caption in small gray text: 'Fix the foundation before building the next layer.'

Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant. Small text 'Kelvin Davis' bottom right corner. Professional LinkedIn infographic style similar to ByteByteGo. White background. No dark backgrounds.
